observations: Scalar multiplication and reverse multiplication first convert through domain_new then call coefficient multiplication.
from_dict calls domain.convert for every coefficient and stores nonzero values; PolyElement.new does not coerce values itself. Admission needs dtype preservation assertions.

_iadd_poly_monom computes accumulator+v*c; imul_num(2) uses in-place coefficientmultiply by Pythoninteger2, except generator path delegatespolynomialmul. Private dtype must support mixedintegercoercion and immutable coefficient results.
PolyElement hash caches ring/frozenset(items); no mutation of hashed polynomial permitted beyond behavior of pinnedalgorithm. Implementation compatibility/determinism control required.
